clips.title: The story
paras: The Hall of the Brave is the grand warrior barracks situated in the eastern heights of Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. It serves as the primary training compound and guild house for the Horde's front-line combatants, drillmasters, and battlemasters.

Overlooking the tranquil waters and training rings of the Valley of Honor, the Hall of the Brave serves as a vital military hub for the burgeoning Horde. Inside, veteran officers and seasoned warriors instruct initiates in the brutal fundamentals of melee combat, stance mastery, and discipline. The hall is lined with training dummies and armaments, housing battlemasters who organize combatants for major military engagements across Azeroth.
